chunks: 5611 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who died and left his parents, he عليه السلام said: "The mother has one-third, and the father has two-thirds."

key_terms.لِلْأَبِ: for the father; indicates the father's assigned inheritance share
key_terms.لِلْأُمِّ: for the mother; indicates the mother's assigned inheritance share

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of the mother and father when a deceased person leaves only parents?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance when a man dies leaving only his two parents. In that case, the mother receives one-third of the estate and the father receives the remaining two-thirds.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5611 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Zurara from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) regarding a man who passed away and left behind his parents.
Imam (as) said: "The mother receives one-third, and the father receives two-thirds."
